package.description: Cloud based deployment solution for Dynamo, Grasshopper, and OkPy content.

en-US.description: Cloud based deployment solution for Dynamo, Grasshopper, and OkPy content.
en-US.longDescription:
Orkestra is a cloud based deployment and automation platform for AEC teams.
It deploys and runs Dynamo, Grasshopper, and OkPy (Python) content across
Autodesk Revit, Civil 3D, and Rhino, with centralized workspaces, package
management, batch runs, playlists, and analytics.
en-US.name: Orkestra
en-US.releaseNotes:
Orkestra 2.5
This release brings the OkPy Agent to Rhino, Civil 3D, AutoCAD and Navisworks in a simplified chat-and-preview mode, lets you draw your changes directly on a tool's interface or on a screen capture, adds a comprehensive Autodesk Construction Cloud toolkit, opens Hosting Spaces to the public API, makes the web app installable on your phone, and fixes a series of issues reported since 2.4.

What's new

OkPy Full Agentic Mode in every host
- The simplified OkPy Agent (chat plus live preview, no editor chrome) is now available in Rhino, Civil 3D, AutoCAD and Navisworks, alongside Revit. Describe the tool you need and watch OkPy build it.
- Improved publish workflow from full agentic mode
- Integration of super chat toggle in full agentic mode

OkPy
- Markup mode: draw directly on the tool's interface with pen, arrow, box and label tools. Marks snap to the control under them. Add notes and send the picture to the agent.
2026-09-09_11-30-17.mp4
- Screen capture: capture the host window, any view or any area, draw on it and attach it to your message. Any attached image can be marked up.
2026-09-11_17-45-21.mp4
- Autodesk Construction Cloud toolkit, comprehensive edition: Issues, RFIs, Submittals, Forms, Photos, Assets, Clash results, Model properties, Reviews, Sheets, Docs metadata, Links and Takeoff, plus project administration. Everything runs through the host's signed-in Autodesk session, with no app registration. Screenshot below is an example showing tool listing ACC Issues , including screenshots, with edit features!
- Long sessions: the agent tracks code state across the conversation and compacts history more intelligently.

Revit, Rhino, Civil 3D and Navisworks plugins
- Rhino Quick Access: hover cards on buttons show the icon, title and description, with a "More info" link for online tools, matching the Revit ribbon.
- Rhino Quick Access: small stacked buttons, like Revit ribbon stacks, and the "Small" button size is honored.

Web app
- Install Orkestra on your phone: the web app is now a Progressive Web App. Add it to your home screen from your phone's browser!
- Analytics: daily runs explorer. Click a bar in the runs-per-day chart to see that day's runs.
- Hosting: clearer warning when unbinding an app from a space.

Platform and security
- Public API: Hosting Spaces. New hosting:read and hosting:write scopes on user API keys give access to spaces and usage, file upload, download and delete, and document insert, query, update and delete, with batch inserts and hourly budgets.
- Wiki pages detect when someone else saved a newer version, so edits no longer overwrite each other.
- Documentation links must use http or https.

Bug fixes

OkPy
- Agent: when one change fails in a multi-step response, the steps that depended on it are skipped instead of running on a broken state.
- Agent: pressing Stop keeps the results of the steps that had already completed. An applied edit is no longer recorded as cancelled.
- Agent: code diffs in the chat no longer overwrite an older message or get lost on Stop.
- Fixed a stall when a tool using the ACC toolkit prompted for Autodesk sign-in during a test run.
- Tool interfaces: controls that did not have enough room were cropped. Button rows, option rows and mode switches now wrap onto a second row.

Web app
- Version rollback fixed.
- Copying or moving several items at once works again. When the destination check cannot be completed for one item, the others are no longer blocked and you can still proceed.
- Wiki: dark theme fixed in ribbon builder viewer mode, and the editor never saves an unreadable page as empty.
- Playlist and batch run history loads faster.
- Faster first load: translations, fonts and heavy editors are loaded only when needed.
- You are only signed out on a genuine session expiry, and sign-out cleans up properly.
- Many small styling and component fixes.
